title: Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy
caption: Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy (V)
game_text: Add one battle destiny at Incinerator, Trash Compactor, Watto’s Junkyard, or a swamp.
lore: Leia led an unorthodox escape into a “garbage masher” on the detention level. “What an incredible smell you’ve discovered!”
